title: Test 01: Technology & Social Media
part1: Do you use social media often?
What’s your favorite website or app?
Do you think people spend too much time online?
part2:
Describe a piece of technology you own that you find very useful.
You should say:
- What it is
- When you got it
- What you use it for
- And explain why you find it so helpful.
part3: How has technology changed the way we communicate?
Do you think older people find it difficult to use modern gadgets?
What are the disadvantages of relying too much on technology?

title: Test 02: Environment & Nature
part1: Do you like visiting natural places?
What is the weather like in your hometown?
Have you ever grown any plants or flowers?
part2:
Describe a beautiful place you visited that was in nature.
You should say:
- Where it was
- Who you went with
- What you did there
- And explain why you think it was beautiful.
part3: Why is it important to protect the environment?
Do you think schools should teach children more about nature?
Is pollution a big problem in your country today?

title: Test 03: Education & Career
part1: Are you a student or are you working?
What is your favorite subject at school/university?
Do you prefer studying alone or with others?
part2:
Describe a course or subject you would like to learn in the future.
You should say:
- What the course is
- Where you would like to study it
- How you heard about it
- And explain why you want to take this course.
part3: Is it better to have a university degree or practical experience?
How has the way people study changed because of the internet?
Do you think lifelong learning is important for everyone?

title: Test Speaking
part1: What do you do?
Where are you from?
part2: Talk about a person who inspires you.
part3: What makes a good role model?
Is celebrity influence positive?

title: IELTS Speaking Test — Topic: Online Shopping and Consumerism
part1: How many languages can you speak? [Why/Why not?]
How useful will English be to you in your future? [Why/Why not?]
What do you remember about learning languages at school? [Why/Why not?]
What do you think would be the hardest language for you to learn? [Why?]
part2:
Describe a website that you bought something from. You should say:
• what the website is
• what you bought from this website
• how satisfied you were with what you bought
and explain what you liked or disliked about using this website.
You will have to talk about the topic for one to two minutes. You have one minute to think about what you are going to say. You can make some notes to help you if you wish.
part3: What kinds of things do people in your country often buy from online shops?
Why do you think online shopping has become so popular nowadays?
What are some possible disadvantages of buying things from online shops?
Why do many people today keep buying things which they do not need?
Do you believe the benefits of a consumer society outweigh the disadvantages?
How possible is it to avoid the culture of consumerism?
